references.text: Describes the same fear of excommunication (being cast out of the synagogue) that prevented confession of faith in Jesus.
Refers to the same secrecy regarding faith due to fear of the religious leaders (the Pharisees).
Describes Nicodemus as one of the leading figures who believed in Jesus but kept himself hidden because of fear of the Jews.
Prophesies that those who kill the disciples will think they are doing God's will, and that they will be cast out of the synagogue, which was the concrete fear mentioned in the verse.
Describes how the religious leaders (the chief priests and the Pharisees) gathered to plan Jesus' death, creating the fear of excommunication mentioned in the verse.
